description: Historical benchmark catalogue of North Indian Ocean monsoon low-pressure systems, depressions, deep depressions, and active/break regime episodes.

invariants.reference_standard: IMD RSMC New Delhi synoptic archives and IMD 0.25-degree daily gridded precipitation.
invariants.anti_leakage: Best-track positions, central pressures, and gridded rainfall fields sealed behind 24h verification latency.

events.name: August 2018 Monsoon Depression & Kerala Surge
events.synoptic_narrative: A depression formed over northwest Bay of Bengal and moved west-northwestwards across Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and Madhya Pradesh, triggering exceptionally active monsoon conditions and severe flooding in Central India and Kerala.

events.name: August 2019 Deep Depression over Bay of Bengal
events.synoptic_narrative: Deep depression traversed from north Bay of Bengal across West Bengal, Odisha, and Central India all the way to Gujarat, generating wide-scale torrential precipitation along the monsoon trough.

events.name: September 2020 Monsoon Depression
events.synoptic_narrative: Late-monsoon depression over west-central Bay of Bengal produced heavy rainfall over coastal Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Maharashtra.

events.name: July 2021 Break-to-Active Transition Spell
events.synoptic_narrative: Prolonged break monsoon conditions with trough at Himalayan foothills terminated rapidly as a low-pressure area organized over north Bay of Bengal, restoring the monsoon trough to normal position.

events.name: August 2022 Deep Depression across Central India to Rajasthan
events.synoptic_narrative: Fast-moving deep depression crossed West Bengal/Odisha coast and tracked rapidly through MP, causing record precipitation and flooding across southern Rajasthan and northern Gujarat.

events.name: August 2023 Extended Break Monsoon Episode
events.synoptic_narrative: Severe August break monsoon episode with anomalous northward shift of the monsoon trough to the foothills of the Himalayas, leading to acute rainfall deficits across central and peninsular India.

events.name: July-August 2024 Monsoon Depression Cluster
events.synoptic_narrative: Series of monsoon low-pressure systems and a depression propagating in quick succession along the monsoon trough, producing sustained torrential rain over Vidarbha, Gujarat, and Saurashtra.
